sentences.text: Béla Ferenc Dezső Blaskó -LRB- -LSB- ˈbeːlɒ ˈfɛrɛnt͡s ˈdɛʒøː ˈblɒʃkoː -RSB- ; 20 October 1882 -- 16 August 1956 -RRB- , better known as Bela Lugosi -LRB- -LSB- ləˈgoʊsi -RSB- -LSB- ˈlugoʃi -RSB- -RRB- , was a Hungarian-American actor , famous for portraying Count Dracula in the 1931 film and for his roles in various other horror films .	Hungarian-American	Hungarian-American	Count Dracula	Count Dracula	1931 film	Dracula (1931 English-language film)	horror films	horror films

He had been playing small parts on the stage in his native Hungary before making his first film in 1917 , but had to leave the country after the failed Hungarian Communist Revolution of 1919 .	the failed Hungarian Communist Revolution of 1919	Hungarian Soviet Republic
He had roles in several films in Weimar Germany before arriving in the United States as a seaman on a merchant ship .	Weimar Germany	Weimar Germany
In 1927 , he appeared as Count Dracula in a Broadway adaptation of Bram Stoker 's novel .	Count Dracula	Count Dracula	Bram Stoker	Bram Stoker	novel	Dracula
He later appeared in the classic 1931 film Dracula by Universal Pictures .	1931 film	Dracula (1931 English-language film)	Universal Pictures	Universal Studios

Through the 1930s , he occupied an important niche in popular horror films , with their East European setting , but his Hungarian accent limited his repertoire , and he tried unsuccessfully to avoid typecasting .	horror films	horror films
Meanwhile , he was often paired with Boris Karloff , who was able to demand top billing .	Boris Karloff	Boris Karloff
To his frustration , Lugosi was increasingly restricted to minor parts , kept employed by the studio principally for the sake of his name on the posters .

Among his pairings with Karloff , only in The Black Cat -LRB- 1934 -RRB- , The Raven -LRB- 1935 -RRB- , and Son of Frankenstein -LRB- 1939 -RRB- did he perform major roles again , and , even in The Raven , Karloff received top billing despite Lugosi performing the lead role .	The Black Cat	The Black Cat (1934 film)	The Raven	The Raven (1935 film)	Son of Frankenstein	Son of Frankenstein
By this time , Lugosi had been receiving regular medication for sciatic neuritis , and he became addicted to morphine and methadone .	sciatic neuritis	sciatica	morphine	morphine	methadone	methadone

This drug dependence was noted by producers , and the offers eventually dwindled down to a few parts in Ed Wood 's low-budget movies , most notably Plan 9 from Outer Space .	Ed Wood	Ed Wood	Plan 9 from Outer Space	Plan 9 from Outer Space
